changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'MapItemMap_backup') BEGIN drop table [dbo].[MapItemMap_backup]; END
changeSet.rollback: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'MapItemMap_backup') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[MapItemMap_backup]( [MapID] [int] NOT NULL, [MapItemID] [int] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_MapItemMap] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [MapID] ASC, [MapItemID] ASC ) ) END
